title: u-g-k.fr — Celui qui pulvérise les certitudes (French UG site)
description: French-language site devoted to U.G. Krishnamurti. Confirmed pages: homepage (https://u-g-k.fr/) and 'Qui est U.G. ? / Découvrir U.G. Krishnamurti' (https://u-g-k.fr/decouvrir-u-g-krishnamurti/) with a biography through his death in 2007. Full site index not retrievable via search.

title: UG : Rencontres avec un éveillé contestataire
description: French translation of The Mystique of Enlightenment by Paule Salvan, Éditions Les Deux Océans, Paris, 1986; reissued 2000 (broché). Translator Paule Salvan.

title: Le mental est un mythe : entretiens déroutants avec U.G. Krishnamurti
description: French translation of Mind Is a Myth. First edition Les Deux Océans 1988 (fr.wikipedia credits translation by Paule Salvan with Yvette Rielle); reissue 3 May 2000, broché 176 pp., ISBN 9782866810238.

title: La Pensée est votre ennemie : entretiens fracassants avec U.G.
description: French translation of Thought Is Your Enemy by Paule Salvan, Les Deux Océans, Paris. Publisher page dated July 1989 (likely later reprint data), ugkrishnamurti.in gives 1992. Broché.

title: nondualite.free.fr — U.G. Krishnamurti pages (French/English)
description: Pages confirmed: c_ugev01.htm (U.G. Krishnamurti : extraits, French quotations), c_ug123.htm (Le Dos au Mur extraits, Terdjman translation), c_ug_courage.htm (English transcript The Courage to Stand Alone, Amsterdam 1982, in three parts), top_en.htm (English index). Mirrored at non-dualite.fr/index.php/fr/hors-tradition/u-g-krishnamurti-le-dos-au-mur.

title: inner-quest.org — U.G. Krishnamurti biography (French and Hindi pages)
description: French biography page UG_Fr.htm and a Hindi page UG_H.htm on inner-quest.org.

title: eti.martin.free.fr — U.G. Krishnamurti : extrait (La Voie du SOI)
description: French excerpt on returning to the natural state, hosted on the 'La Voie du SOI' pages.

title: 悟りという謎 (Satori to iu nazo) — Japanese translation of The Mystique of Enlightenment (unofficial, YouTube/blog)
description: Blogger of 'シンプル道の日々' publishes a Japanese translation of The Mystique of Enlightenment under the title 悟りという謎, released on YouTube (2025), arguing the text is public domain. Earlier post (2014) 'もう一人のクリシュナムルティ' introduces UG. Blog takutakugood.blogspot.com (2020) states no UG book had then been published in Japanese.

title: Tek Başına Durma Cesareti (Turkish Courage to Stand Alone)
description: Turkish translation of Courage to Stand Alone by Efehan Boyacıoğlu, Ganj Kitap, 2018, 160 pp., karton kapak, ISBN 9786055006877.

title: Korean Wikipedia article U. G. 크리슈나무르티
description: Korean-language encyclopedia entry; lists Mind Is a Myth (Smriti Books 2003, ISBN 81-87967-10-2) but gives no Korean print edition. No Korean translation found.

title: WELL U.G. archive (people.well.com/user/jct) — confirmed file inventory, batch 1
description: Confirmed filenames and titles: display.htm ('about UG Krishnamurti', frame/landing); Final_Remembering.htm ('Remembering UG Krishnamurti'); ntbook3.htm ('What the Press and Others Say About U.G.'); nwo1.htm ('No Way Out: Chapter 1'); intro.html ('Mind is a Myth / Introduction'); mystiq1.htm ('MYSTIQUE OF ENLIGHTENMENT: Pt.1: U.G.'); enemy0.htm ('Thought is your Enemy', title page); ThoughtG.html; science.html ('Science and Spirituality', 1995 paper by Moorty presented at a Krishnamurti centennial conference); lists.html ('Books, Interviews, and References'); ugbio/ugbtitle.htm ('UG Biography — Title Page'), ugbio/ugbintro.htm ('Introduction'), ugbio/ugbio4.htm ('4. Locking of Horns'), ugbio/ugbconv.htm ('Part II: Conversations'); SIT/part_ii.htm ('Part II' of Stopped in Our Tracks); bphotos/ug_1.htm ('U.G.Krishnamurti - Photos'), bphotos/val_ol~2.htm ('UG Krishnamurti: A Life'), bphotos/ph5.htm ('UG Biography — Photos'); GERMAN/Das_Ende_der_Sehnsucht/Inhalt_und_Einleitung.htm (German Mind is a Myth). Not surfaced by search: natural_state.htm, links.htm, thought.htm, chandra.htm, reddi.htm, sage*.htm, courage files, About_UG.pdf, leftcol.htm.

title: Stopped in Our Tracks: Stories of U.G. in India — editions and ISBNs
description: From the Telugu notebooks of K. Chandrasekhar, translated and edited by J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty. Smriti Books 2005, 166 pp., ISBN 8187967765 / 9788187967767. Winsome Books India 2009 (165 pp.) and 2022 reprint (200 pp.), ISBN 818804363X / 9788188043637. Full text on archive.org (227 pp. combined series). Separate ISBNs for 'second series' / 'third series' not found via search.

title: The Courage to Stand Alone: Conversations with U.G. Krishnamurti — Plover Press 1997 ISBN
description: Plover Press, Brooklyn, N.Y., distributed by Autonomedia, 1997. ISBN 1570270376 / 9781570270376 (Amazon.de lists same ISBN under Semiotext(e), 1 Dec 1997). Later revised edition Non-Duality Press/New Harbinger ISBN 9781908664280 (ed. Ellen Chrystal); Good Press 2022 e-edition ISBN 9788027246571.

title: Thought Is Your Enemy — Sowmya Publishers, Bangalore, 1990/1991
description: Edited by Antony Paul Frank Noronha and J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty; Sowmya Publishers, Fraser Town, Bangalore; first print October 1990, second print August 1991. Discussions 1985–1990 in India, Switzerland, Australia, Netherlands, UK. No ISBN found for the Sowmya printings (later reprint ISBNs 9781591810650 (2007) and 9789350290095 (2010) belong to other publishers).

title: Get Lost and Stay Lost: Travels with UG Krishnamurti / UG Krishnamurti Cookbook
description: Attributed to Julie Thayer (photographer-companion of UG). Only an unofficial upload (dokumen.pub) surfaced; no publisher or ISBN confirmed.

title: Goner: The Final Travels of UG Krishnamurti (revised)
description: Louis Brawley's memoir of UG's last years; revised edition ISBN 9780956643278 (Non-Duality Press).

title: God Men Con Men — Robert Carr (with audio disc of conversations with U.G.)
description: Robert (Bob) Carr (b. 1928), artist, magician, television producer, who met UG in Switzerland in 1966 and spent ~20 years with him. Smriti Books 2003 edition with accompanying sound disc 'Conversations with U.G. Krishnamurti' (WorldCat OCLC 56594816). Later edition 'God Men Con Men: Pursuit of Truth', ISBN 9780990585046. Carr also wrote the introduction to The End of All Beginnings (2014, ISBN 099058500X). No separate Carr film on UG confirmed.

title: The End of All Beginnings: Encounters with the Natural State
description: 2014 compilation of encounters with UG; introduction by Robert Carr; ISBN 099058500X.

title: 14 Days in Palm Springs with U.G. Krishnamurti / In Palm Springs with U.G. Krishnamurti — Sabyasachi Guha
description: Memoir by Sabyasachi Guha, begun as letters to a friend in Kolkata; preface dated October 2007. Published by Motilal Banarsidass 2021 as 'In Palm Springs with U.G. Krishnamurti', hardcover ISBN 9789391024239, paperback ISBN 9789391024314. Circulates unofficially as '14 Days in Palm Springs with UG Krishnamurti' (dokumen.pub, dated 2023). Author is Guha alone (not Lakshmi).

title: Back to Square One: Conversations with Sabyasachi Guha
description: Parting Shot Press 2015, 230 pp. paperback, ISBN 1936940892 / 9781936940899. Conversations driven by Guha's contact with UG.

title: Life Finds Its Way: Reflections on Reality with Sabyasachi Guha
description: Edited by Nandini Kapadia; Zen Publications 2019; ISBN 9789387242357.

title: Guha Talks with the Mother of God
description: Epigraph Books, 2012 (listed on WELL lists.html; no ISBN in results). WELL list also notes Guha's 2011 Bengali translation of Mahesh Bhatt's UG biography.

title: The Ashes Are Warm: Memories of a Lifetime Spent with UG Krishnamurti
description: Mahesh Bhatt as told to Sunita Pant Bansal, built from Bhatt's diary jottings. Rupa Publications, paperback 384 pp., ISBN 978-93-7646-180-6, published 5 April 2026 (Amazon: 30 April 2026, 352 pp., Kindle B0GX2WTJ87), Rs 495. Excerpts in Scroll (17 May 2026) and ThePrint; review Free Press Journal July 2026.

title: UG's Theosophical Society career — key events (secondary sources)
description: Timeline: Dec 1932 TS convention, met Besant; Jinarajadasa gave him the book 'I Promise'; c.1939–41 worked in Leadbeater's library, joined TS as lecturer; Joint General Secretary of Indian Section, then National Lecturer for seven years, lectured in Europe; 1949 first visit to New York as international lecturer; July 1953 final break with TS and Jinarajadasa. No primary Theosophist/Adyar bulletin item or iapsop scan surfaced.

title: J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty, 'Fragmentation, Meditation and Transformation', JICPR V.2 (Jan–Apr 1988)
host: Journal of Indian Council of Philosophical Research
description: Article on J. Krishnamurti's thought in JICPR Vol. V No. 2 (1988). UG connection: Moorty showed it to UG, whose only comment was that it clarified difficulties readers have with JK. Moorty's site also lists his 1991 introduction to No Way Out and the 1995 'Science and Spirituality' centennial paper (WELL science.html).

title: Telugu editions of UG books (J.S. Subrahmanyam / Kinige / Master Yogashram / C.P. Brown Academy)
host: Kinige / Master Yogashram / C.P. Brown Academy
description: Telugu items surfaced: 'U.G. Krishnamurti – Oka Jeevita Katha' (K. Chandrasekhar's Telugu translation of Mahesh Bhatt biography, 1994); 'Manasoka Mithya' (Mind is a Myth, Telugu, J.S. Subrahmanyam, Amazon listing 26 Nov 2022); 'Gnanodaya Rahasyam' (Mystique of Enlightenment, revised, J.S. Subrahmanyam, Kinige); 'About U.G. Krishnamurti?' Telugu edition (Subrahmanyam, 38 pp., ISBN 9781543160451); 'U.G. Krishnamurti – Jeevitam, Tatvikata' (Master Sarvari, Master Yogashram, Secunderabad 2008; 2020 ed. 208 pp.); 'U.G. Krishnamurti – Jeevitam, Drkpatham' (Abburi Chayadevi, C.P. Brown Academy, Hyderabad 2011). Telugu titles of Chandrasekhar's own notebooks still not confirmed.

title: Akshaya Publications, Bangalore — UG titles
description: Akshaya Publications, Bangalore: 'U.G. Alla Guruji' (Kannada) by Y.N. Krishnamurti (YNK, editor of Kannada Prabha), 1995; 'No Way Out — Further Dialogues with U.G.' (English) ed. Moorty & Noronha. WELL list also records 1978 Kannada 'Illi Vadavilla – Iruvudella Veda' (B.A. Ranganath) and Chennai 2005 'Ennamthan Ungalin Ethiri' / 'Maatrapaduvatharku Ethuvumillai' (these two are Tamil, Kannadasan Pathippagam, already catalogued). No ISBNs for Akshaya editions found.

title: दिमाग ही दुश्मन है (Dimag Hi Dushman Hai) — Hindi Thought Is Your Enemy
description: Hindi edition of Thought Is Your Enemy, 168 pp.; circulates on PDF sites (44books, ourhindi) without publisher named. No Rajpal / Hind Pocket / Manjul / Rajkamal UG titles found.

title: WELL U.G. archive — confirmed file inventory, batch 2
description: Additional confirmed filenames/titles: reddi.htm ('Science and U.G.'); chandra.htm ('U.G.Krishnamurti — Excerpts from Dialogues'); note.htm ('Thought is Your Enemy: Note'); sagecon.htm ('Sage and Housewife: Note and Contents'); sage4.htm ('THE SAGE AND THE HOUSEWIFE: Ch.4', implies sage1..sageN series); Talk.htm ('FIRST AND LAST PUBLIC TALK OF U.G. AFTER HIS CALAMITY'); Sempe.htm ('THE CASE OF U', Sempé text); ugbio/ugbio5.htm ('5. Adrift in London', contains 30 Dec 1961 letter to wife and 7 Sep 1963 letter to swami at the London Ramakrishna Vedanta Centre), ugbio/ugbio9.htm, ugbio/ugbio10.htm ('10. Years After'). Still unconfirmed by search: natural_state.htm, links.htm, thought.htm, About_UG.pdf, leftcol.htm, courage*.htm, mystiq2-4, enemy1..N, nwo2..11 (series existence implied by mystiq1/enemy0/nwo1).

title: The Sage and the Housewife — Shanta Kelker (1990, Bangalore; Smriti 2005)
description: First published 1990 in Bangalore; later edition Smriti Books 2005. Full text on WELL (sagecon.htm, sage1..N.htm) and Wikisource.

title: Letters from London: 30 Dec 1961 to his wife; 7 Sep 1963 to swami, Ramakrishna Vedanta Centre
description: Primary documents quoted in Mahesh Bhatt's 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life', chapter 5 'Adrift in London': UG's last letter to his wife dated 30 December 1961 ending the relationship, and a 7 September 1963 letter to a swami at the Ramakrishna Vedanta Centre (London) thanking him for news of an eye operation, written shortly before leaving; ugkrishnamurti.in timeline confirms 1960–63 stay at the Centre. (The '1961 letter to the London Ramakrishna Mission' in the brief appears to be this material.) Also mirrored at ug-k.blogspot.com.

title: Editors of the English conversation books: Newland, Chrystal, Arms, Maverick
description: Terry Newland edited Mind Is a Myth (1987/88, with introduction; Smriti 2003 edition catalogued on PhilPapers with Sunita Pant Bansal as co-editor); Ellen J. Chrystal transcribed/edited The Courage to Stand Alone (Plover 1997; Smriti 2001/2005; Motilal 2002); Rodney Arms edited The Mystique of Enlightenment (Dinesh/Goa 1982; Sentient 2002, ISBN 9780971078611); Peter Maverick compiled The Natural State: In the Words of U.G. Krishnamurti (2005). No standalone memoirs or articles about UG by these editors surfaced beyond their introductions.

title: Mystique of Enlightenment — Dinesh/Cemetile 1982 (no ISBN found) and later ISBNs
description: The 1982 Dinesh Publications / Cemetile Corp., Goa edition did not surface in search with an ISBN. Later editions: Sentient Publications April 2002, 159 pp., ISBN 9780971078611; Smriti/Winsome 'Conversations with U.G. Krishnamurti' ISBN 9788188043590; e-artnow ISBN 9788027341443; Sharp Ink ebook ISBN 9788028286125. Mind Is a Myth: Dinesh Publications Goa 1988; Smriti 2003 ISBN 8187967102; Winsome 2009 ISBN 9788188043613; Sentient 2007 ISBN 9781591810650; PSB Enterprises 2002.

title: Robert Trochonowicz, 'Total helplessness: A critical reconstruction of the concept of enlightenment in the philosophy of Uppaluri Gopala Krishnamurti', ARGUMENT 12(2) 2022
description: ARGUMENT vol. 12 no. 2 (2022), pp. 579–591, DOI 10.24917/20841043.12.2.12 (PhilPapers dates it 2023). Naturalistic/physiological reconstruction of UG's concept of enlightenment. PDF on academia.edu.

title: T.R. Raghunath, 'The Unrational Philosophy of U.G. Krishnamurti' (chapter 1, PDF)
description: Chapter 1 'The Unrational Philosophy of U.G. Krishnamurti' by Dr. T.R. Raghunath, hosted as PDF on stillnessspeaks.com (pp. 13ff.); parent volume not identified in search.

title: fr.wikisource — Le mental est un mythe (U. G. Krishnamurti) (bilingue), traduction en cours
description: Bilingual English–French column translation of Mind Is a Myth in the Wikisource:Traductions space, marked 'traduction en cours'; source text from well.com; started by user Vatadoshu c. Sept 2017 (Scriptorium discussion). Author page Auteur:Uppaluri_Gopala_Krishnamurti exists. Discussion pages flag conflict with the commercial Deux Océans translation.

title: The Theosophist, June 1948 (vol. 69 no. 9), ed. C. Jinarajadasa — iapsop scan (lead for UG items)
description: iapsop.com hosts scans of The Theosophist for the years UG lectured for the Indian Section (c. 1941–53); this June 1948 issue is one example. No search hit confirms a UG item inside; theosophy.world 'India, Theosophy in' and Rohit Mehta (Indian Section General Secretary 1945–59) pages give context. Lead only.

title: Portuguese (Brazil) — no UG edition found; blog 'UG Krishnamurti: um filósofo radical'
description: Only Portuguese-language item surfaced: blog page 'Sobre UG Krishnamurti – O Filósofo Radical' (O Mundo de Agharta). Estante Virtual search returns only English imports / J.K. titles. An Etsy listing uses the title 'A mente é um mito' for an English PDF.

title: Tamil UG titles at udumalai.com bookseller (incl. மூளைதனமே மூலதனம்)
description: Tamil bookseller listing of U.G. Krishnamoorthy books, including 'மூளைதனமே மூலதனம் பாகம் 1' — a title not among the five Kannadasan Pathippagam books already catalogued; publisher not shown in snippet.
